# Knowledge map: Menu model and touch UI

<!-- Generated by `python -m tools.research.knowledge_map build` from `docs/map/sources/menu-touch-ui.toml`. Do not edit by hand. -->

- **Scope:** Camera menu tree, WidgetSystem, original selection/activation, resource and sprite captures, menu .uxc containers and the touch prototypes up to the live MTF2 touch mod.
- **Evidence span:** see record index; last reviewed 2026-11-22.
- **Deep review:** 0 of 55 records read in full and checked claim by claim ([curation plan](CURATION_PLAN.md)); the rest are curated from titles, lead paragraphs and consolidated documents.
- **Status legend:** PHYSICAL = observed on the camera/host; OFFLINE = disassembly, Unicorn or static proof; INFERENCE = argued from evidence, not observed directly; RETRACTED/REFUTED = do not rely on, kept to prevent re-derivation.

The evidence records are authoritative; follow the links before acting on a claim.

## Entities

### <a id="ui-widget-system"></a>WidgetSystem, menu model and selection

`ui.widget-system` | process

Native WidgetSystem singleton and layer list, the camera menu model, original selection/activation routes and the controller refresh contract.

Current knowledge:

- **C01** `PHYSICAL` Early touch hooks false-matched and were disabled; live touch returned ENODEV and the first physical menu-touch tests were negative. ([E0085](../evidence/0085-touch-hook-false-matches-and-live-disable.md), [E0086](../evidence/0086-live-touch-enodev-and-menu-instruction-audit.md), [E0089](../evidence/0089-native-gates-applied-but-menu-touch-negative.md), [E0093](../evidence/0093-menu-probe-negative-and-verified-multiclass-catalog.md))
- **C02** `PHYSICAL` The native WidgetSystem singleton and layer list were observed; a physical menu test reaches WidgetSystem mouse records and the actual menu tree and mouse-handler boundary. ([E0094](../evidence/0094-widget-system-singleton-and-layer-list.md), [E0095](../evidence/0095-native-mouse-observer-running.md), [E0096](../evidence/0096-menu-test-reaches-widget-mouse-records.md), [E0097](../evidence/0097-real-menu-widget-tree-and-mouse-handlers.md))
- **C03** `OFFLINE` The camera menu model and original selection execute on captured state; menu binding, refresh, action route, widget lookup and world geometry were recovered, and row hit checks are separate from selection controls. ([E0099](../evidence/0099-camera-menu-model-and-original-selection-execution.md), [E0100](../evidence/0100-original-menu-binding-refresh-and-controller-capture.md), [E0103](../evidence/0103-original-action-route-selected-node-and-geometry-primitives.md), [E0104](../evidence/0104-original-widget-lookup-and-active-layout-snapshot.md), [E0106](../evidence/0106-complete-active-menu-lookup-and-world-geometry.md), [E0108](../evidence/0108-original-row-hit-and-selection-controls.md))
- **C05** `PHYSICAL` A natural touch UI thread and release coordinates were observed; coupled physical touch maps to row 6, with native bindings, popup guards and the refresh ABI. ([E0127](../evidence/0127-touch-policy-native-event-abi-and-forwarding-trace.md), [E0128](../evidence/0128-natural-touch-ui-thread-and-release-coordinate-trace.md), [E0130](../evidence/0130-coupled-touch-row-six-and-original-selection.md), [E0131](../evidence/0131-native-bindings-popup-guards-and-refresh-argument.md))
- **C10** `PHYSICAL` Live module maps gave a guarded native touch candidate; a camera ELF touch symbol enabled guarded deployment. ([E0087](../evidence/0087-live-module-maps-and-guarded-native-touch-candidate.md), [E0088](../evidence/0088-camera-elf-touch-symbol-and-guarded-deployment.md))
- **C11** `PHYSICAL` The original cursor read contract, a selection-state observer, a live menu controller with original selection-synchronization replay and the controller observer's coverage limit were recorded. ([E0098](../evidence/0098-original-cursor-contract-and-menu-state-observer.md), [E0101](../evidence/0101-controller-observer-coverage-failure-and-menu-trigger.md), [E0102](../evidence/0102-live-menu-controller-and-selection-sync-replay.md))
- **C12** `PHYSICAL` The active layout was captured (first incomplete, then by binary recursive capture); the retained model matches the active menu and rows associate natively. ([E0105](../evidence/0105-active-layout-partial-output-and-binary-recursive-capture.md), [E0107](../evidence/0107-active-menu-model-and-row-association.md))
- **C14** `OFFLINE` Coordinate controls and a separate refresh path were prepared ahead of the coupled touch capture. ([E0129](../evidence/0129-local-coordinate-controls-refresh-path-and-coupled-touch-capture.md))

### <a id="ui-resource-manager"></a>ResourceManager, sprites and bitmaps

`ui.resource-manager` | process

Resource accounting, fastbin-linked coupled captures (V4..V12), sprite element arrays, packed resource indices and BitmapImpl round trips.

Current knowledge:

- **C04** `OFFLINE` Original activation reaches thread and resource-management contracts; coupled captures V4..V12 bound the fastbin chain, sprite references, packed indices and BitmapImpl round trips. ([E0109](../evidence/0109-original-activation-thread-context-and-resource-boundary.md), [E0115](../evidence/0115-v4-capture-archived-and-resource-unlink-boundary.md), [E0118](../evidence/0118-fastbin-chain-bound-and-prefix-preflight.md), [E0122](../evidence/0122-v8-coupled-image-path-and-sprite-reference-capture.md), [E0124](../evidence/0124-v10-packed-index-capture-and-bitmap-implementation.md), [E0125](../evidence/0125-v11-bitmap-roundtrips-and-sprite-element-capture.md), [E0126](../evidence/0126-v12-capture-and-minimal-touch-prototype-scope.md))
- **C13** `PHYSICAL` Resource accounting and original free showed a lifetime mismatch; active-menu references were confirmed, and coupled captures needed a shared freeze: V5 row entry and allocator boundary, a same-freeze fastbin-linked capture, the V6 prefix and payload header, V7 original allocation and rebind, ResourceManager/image accessor and the V9 sprite index. ([E0111](../evidence/0111-resource-accounting-list-ownership-and-snapshot-lifetime.md), [E0112](../evidence/0112-active-menu-resource-lifetime-observer.md), [E0113](../evidence/0113-active-menu-reference-confirmed-and-cache-coherence.md), [E0114](../evidence/0114-coupled-active-resource-model-and-arena-capture.md), [E0116](../evidence/0116-v5-capture-native-row-entry-and-allocator-boundary.md), [E0117](../evidence/0117-fastbin-linked-capture-observer.md), [E0119](../evidence/0119-v6-prefix-capture-and-resource-payload-header.md), [E0120](../evidence/0120-v7-capture-original-fastbin-allocation-and-resource-rebind.md), [E0121](../evidence/0121-resource-manager-image-accessor-and-coupled-contract-capture.md), [E0123](../evidence/0123-v9-sprite-capture-and-packed-resource-index-contract.md))

### <a id="ui-uxc-menu"></a>ViewSettingMenu and .uxc menu containers

`ui.uxc-menu` | process | inventory `firmware.elf:nflasha15_unpacked/lib/viewUnified2.so`

Offline ViewSettingMenu/CmnViewSettingNode architecture, the uxc container format, the reconstructed node tree and the complete menu tree for mode 67 (ILCE-6400).

Aliases: `uxc`, `CmnViewSettingNode`, `Mode 67`

Current knowledge:

- **C06** `OFFLINE` The ViewSettingMenu/CmnViewSettingNode binary layout, the uxc container format and string resolution give a complete menu tree for mode 67 (ILCE-6400) with runtime limits and modification contracts. ([E0511](../evidence/0511-viewsettingmenu-uxc-and-node-architecture.md), [E0512](../evidence/0512-cmnviewsettingproperties-and-setting-node-layout.md), [E0513](../evidence/0513-uxc-container-and-string-resource-resolution.md), [E0514](../evidence/0514-viewsettingmenu-node-tree-reconstruction.md), [E0515](../evidence/0515-complete-menu-tree-modes-and-modification-contracts.md))
- **C07** `OFFLINE` PAS_MenuListTab's vtable and object layout (tab/row/page widget arrays) give the offline touch baseline and a full main-menu touch prototype. ([E0516](../evidence/0516-main-menu-touch-architecture-and-gaps.md), [E0517](../evidence/0517-pas-menulisttab-widgets-tabs-and-enter-action.md), [E0518](../evidence/0518-full-menu-touch-prototype-and-tab-page-bindings.md))
- **C09** `OFFLINE` The Mods tab icon comes from a uxd image container; Mod Loader OK-key routing on tab 7 was diagnosed. ([E0522](../evidence/0522-mods-tab-icon-and-uxd-image-container.md), [E0523](../evidence/0523-mod-loader-ok-routing-diagnostics.md))

### <a id="mod-mtf2-touch"></a>MTF2 full-menu touch mod

`mod.mtf2-touch` | module

Dual-hook touch mod (tools/native_camera/menu_touch_full.c) giving tabs, page dots, rows and tap-to-enter on the main menu.

Aliases: `menu_touch_full.c`, `PAS_MenuListTab`

Current knowledge:

- **C07** `OFFLINE` PAS_MenuListTab's vtable and object layout (tab/row/page widget arrays) give the offline touch baseline and a full main-menu touch prototype. ([E0516](../evidence/0516-main-menu-touch-architecture-and-gaps.md), [E0517](../evidence/0517-pas-menulisttab-widgets-tabs-and-enter-action.md), [E0518](../evidence/0518-full-menu-touch-prototype-and-tab-page-bindings.md))
- **C08** `PHYSICAL` The MTF2 full-menu touch mod was verified live on an ILCE-6400 in RAM-only deployment (op=1), without flash writes; v1 touch was validated and v2 added swipe and popup support. ([E0519](../evidence/0519-refined-menu-touch-swipe-and-popup.md), [E0520](../evidence/0520-mtf2-full-menu-touch-verified-on-a6400.md))
- **C10** `PHYSICAL` Live module maps gave a guarded native touch candidate; a camera ELF touch symbol enabled guarded deployment. ([E0087](../evidence/0087-live-module-maps-and-guarded-native-touch-candidate.md), [E0088](../evidence/0088-camera-elf-touch-symbol-and-guarded-deployment.md))
